envelope.description: Fix the gateway-extension compile break (delegate + 4 test doubles)

body.title: Fix the gateway-extension compile break (delegate + 4 test doubles)
body.summary: Add the settingsCatalog() delegate to DaemonGatewayService (forwarding to the impl) and a trivial `override fun settingsCatalog()` stub returning a canned Unavailable/Loaded to the four DaemonGateway test doubles (DaemonLifecycleServiceTest, OnboardingCleanupIntegrationTest, OnboardingWiringTest, OnboardingLifecycleTest), all in this change so the module compiles.
acceptanceChecks: DaemonGatewayService exposes settingsCatalog() delegating to the impl.
All four test doubles override settingsCatalog(); `./gradlew test` compiles the test source set green (no other double left unimplemented).

tests.name: the full ./gradlew test suite compiles + passes green (the delegate + 4 test-double overrides are proven by the test source set building)
